reviews.name: Maria S.
reviews.body: Had a terrible leak on a Saturday morning. Called Joshua Plumbing, and they were here within hours. The plumber was so friendly and fixed everything fast. Lifesavers!

reviews.name: David Chen
reviews.body: We've used Joshua Plumbing for years, mostly for drain cleaning. Always professional, on time, and they get the job done right without any fuss. Good value too.

reviews.name: Jessica L.
reviews.body: Needed a new water heater installed quickly for a tenant. Joshua Plumbing scheduled it same-day and the installation was flawless. Appreciate the dependable service from a local family business.
